links.outcome: Whether the agent declines out-of-scope requests for medical advice
links.effect: Evaluations show the agent declines requests for medical advice and answers with verifiable evidence. No numbers are given in the abstract.

unlisted_practices: Building a knowledge graph from online patient narratives, grounded in MedDRA terminology, to complement pharmacovigilance

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel LLM-KG agent (AskGLP1) for extracting patient experiences from social media and answering pharmacovigilance questions without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
